blocks.text: Clear Skin, Healthy Barrier: Treating Acne, Oily Skin & Open Pores with Care
blocks.html: Clear Skin, Healthy Barrier: Treating Acne, Oily Skin & Open Pores with Care

At Elements Wellness, we believe that clear, glowing skin doesn’t mean compromising the skin’s natural barrier. While we effectively treat acne, control excess oil, and minimize open pores, our focus is on restoring the skin’s health—not disrupting its delicate balance.

blocks.text: Acne: Clearing Breakouts Without Compromising Your Skin
blocks.html: Acne: Clearing Breakouts Without Compromising Your Skin

Acne is often triggered by a mix of hormonal changes, clogged pores, and excess oil production. When pores become clogged with sebum (oil) and dead skin cells, it creates an ideal environment for bacteria to grow, leading to pimples and breakouts. While our facials are designed to clear acne and reduce breakouts, we take special care to respect your skin’s natural barrier. Our HydroLux Acne Defense Facial uses anti-inflammatory ingredients and vortex infusion technology that effectively cleanses and exfoliates to target the root causes of acne, while maintaining a healthy pH balance and protecting the skin from irritation.

blocks.text: Oily Skin: Balancing Oil Production for a Fresh, Healthy Look
blocks.html: Oily Skin: Balancing Oil Production for a Fresh, Healthy Look

While oily skin can help protect against environmental stressors, excessive oil production can lead to clogged pores and an uneven, shiny complexion. Oily skin can feel frustrating, but stripping it away completely can lead to dryness and irritation. Our approach is to clear excess oil without over-drying the skin. With our Black Magnelight Facial, we focus on balancing oil production while nourishing and restoring your skin’s natural moisture levels, leaving you with a matte, yet healthy complexion.

blocks.text: Open Pores: Refining Skin Without Disrupting Its Balance
blocks.html: Open Pores: Refining Skin Without Disrupting Its Balance

Open or enlarged pores occur when skin loses elasticity, often due to aging, sun exposure, or excess oil production. Our IPL Facial works to minimize open pores by tightening and refining the skin while controlling sebum levels. We do this gently, ensuring that your skin’s natural barrier remains intact and your pH balance is maintained for long-lasting, glowing results.
Our goal is simple: to restore your skin’s natural balance, leaving it healthy, glowing, and protected. Whether you’re dealing with acne, oily skin, or enlarged pores, we approach each treatment with care to restore your skin to its healthiest state, respecting its delicate barrier every step of the way.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions on Acne or Oily Skin Facials
blocks.html: Frequently Asked Questions on Acne or Oily Skin Facials

items.q: Will extractions make my acne worse or leave scars?
items.a: When done professionally, extractions help reduce clogged pores and prevent breakouts. Our therapists are trained to perform gentle extractions, minimising trauma to the skin and helping it heal faster — no harsh squeezing involved.

items.q: Can this facial help reduce acne scars or post-inflammatory marks?
items.a: This facial primarily targets active acne and excess oil, but by improving skin texture and reducing inflammation, it can support skin recovery. For deep scarring, we may recommend pairing this with LED light therapy or targeted treatments — which we’ll advise on during your consultation.

items.q: How often should I come for an acne or oily skin facial?
items.a: For oily or acne-prone skin, we usually recommend coming in every 2 to 4 weeks initially, depending on your skin condition. Once things stabilise, you can switch to maintenance facials every 4–6 weeks.

items.q: Will my pores really shrink after this facial?
items.a: Pores don’t physically shrink, but we can minimise their appearance by clearing buildup, refining skin texture, and improving elasticity. With consistent care, pores look smaller and less visible over time.
